assertions: The ship is living and afloat, not sunk or totally wrecked — the repeated reports of her loss are false or greatly exaggerated
She has been in real danger and suffered damage/distress on the voyage (battered by weather, strained or damaged in her hull/body), but the damage is not fatal and she has not gone down
The ship herself and her company/crew are preserved — she is safe for the present, lying in or close to a harbour/roadstead on the coast of Spain to which she was sent to trade
Her position is to the west/south-westward from London, under land/on that Spanish coast rather than lost in the open sea
Her cargo/venture is not wholly lost — the substance of the ship's adventure is preserved, though with loss or charge from the damage she has sustained

Certain news of her safety will come very soon, within a few days (not weeks or months), by letter/messenger, because the Moon wants only a few minutes of perfecting her trine to Mercury, natural significator of news
summary: The ship is alive and safe on the Spanish coast despite damage and false wreck reports, and certain news of her will arrive within a few days.
method: Classical horary astrology (Lilly, whole-sign/traditional dignities): Ascendant and its lady the Moon as significators of the ship
reasoning: Ascendant Cancer is the bulk/body of the ship; its lady Moon is in Taurus in the 11th in exaltation, essentially very strong, near Jupiter the great benefic, and applying within a few minutes by trine to Sun and Mercury in the 7th — strong testimony of preservation and of imminent news via Mercury. Saturn in Aries in the 11th in fall squaring the Ascendant very nearly, and South Node in the 9th of voyages, show the peril, storm-damage and alarming reports and why insurers refused, but Saturn is debilitated, does not afflict the Moon by hard aspect or conjunction, and is not lord of the Ascendant or in the 8th, so affliction falls short of sinking/total loss. Part of Fortune disposed of by Mars with Mercury in reception with Mars supports preservation of the venture rather than total loss of ship and goods. Moon in a fixed earth sign and in aspect to planets in the western 7th places her fast/under land on the traded-to coast westward, and the almost-perfected Moon-Mercury trine gives news in days.
